description: Use this when an owner asks what Phorme paid them, or what goes out next, for example "what did Phorme pay my gym?". It returns what the account earned, what was paid out, what is going out, what is owed now, whether a bank is set up, and each recent payout. It reads only and changes nothing. It needs a connected Phorme account.
name: get_payouts

balance.description: earned_cents, paid_cents, going_out_cents, available_cents, min_payout_cents and payouts_ready. Null when it is read in the console.

payouts.description: payout_id, amount_cents, status (pending, paid or failed) and created_at, newest first.

title: Get my payouts
